question: The main theme of the passage is:

options.text: where the phenomenon of pink water occurs in the world
why the water in some parts of Mumbai wetland has turned pink
how the flamingos get their pink colour

solution:
The correct answer is **'****why the water in some parts of Mumbai wetland has turned pink.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is trying to find out the reasons for changing the wetland of some parts of Mumbai into pink.
 
• It can be concluded from the passage that the main theme of the passage is why the water in some parts of Mumbai wetland has turned pink. (परिच्छेद से यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि मार्ग का मुख्य विषय यह है कि मुंबई आर्द्रभूमि के कुछ हिस्सों में पानी गुलाबी क्यों हो गया है।)
 
• Therefore, the correct option is 'why the water in some parts of Mumbai wetland has turned pink.'

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 *

 
• The meaning of the word** 'phenomenon' **is something that exists and can be seen, felt, tasted, etc., especially something unusual or interesting.

 
 
• **Example**: *Gravity is a natural **phenomenon**.*
